heroHeadline: Colombia Earthquake Toll Hits 294, Losses Estimated at $9.6 Billion
heroSubtitle: A week after the magnitude-7.4 quake killed hundreds and left thousands homeless in Chocó and the Coffee Region, President de la Espriella declared an economic emergency, launched the 'Fondo Milagro' reconstruction fund, and asked Trump to suspend tariffs on Colombian exports — even as a dispute over a rejected Mexican rescue brigade fueled accusations his government screened aid by ideology. The crisis interrupted his hardline security offensive, which killed FARC dissident commander 'El Ruso' in Meta days after his August 7 inauguration.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, Registraduría Nacional, and major international outlets.
